# Rights Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:RightsType`](gmeow-RightsType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/RightsType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A kind of intellectual-property right — an OPEN value vocabulary (copyright, trademark, patent, industrial design, trade secret, related rights, moral rights, database right, plant breeders' rights), linked to Wikidata / WIPO.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:RightsType`](gmeow-RightsType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use as the open value vocabulary for the IP-right-kind axis — the right(s) a statement concerns (copyright, trademark, patent, moral rights, database right, …), referenced via [`gmeow:rightsType`](../properties/gmeow-rightsType.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid minting per-kind subclasses (right kinds are individuals, [Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)) and avoid using it for the standing of a right, which is [`gmeow:copyrightStatus`](../properties/gmeow-copyrightStatus.md) / [`gmeow:trademarkStatus`](../properties/gmeow-trademarkStatus.md).

### How to use

- Reference a seeded value ([`gmeow:rightsTypeCopyright`](../individuals/gmeow-rightsTypeCopyright.md), [`gmeow:rightsTypeTrademark`](../individuals/gmeow-rightsTypeTrademark.md), …) from [`gmeow:rightsType`](../properties/gmeow-rightsType.md); the values are linked to Wikidata / WIPO by reference, and a new kind is a fresh individual.

### Examples

- ex:rtPatent a [`gmeow:RightsType`](gmeow-RightsType.md); [rdfs:label](http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#label) "patent"@en.
